competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance. Increases your Attack Bar by 30% if all your skills are on cooldown.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If all your skills are on cooldown.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit decreases their Attack Power for 2 turns with a 50% chance and blocks them from receiving beneficial effects for 2 turns with a 50% chance. In addition, increases your Attack Bar by 15% for each harmful effect granted on the enemies after the attack.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
All beneficial effects will be blocked
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: For each harmful effect granted on the enemies after the attack.

competences.description: Grants Reflect Harmful Effect on all allies for 1 turn at the start of your turn, and decreases the damage that other allies receive by 20%. In addition, increases your Attack Bar by 10% when an ally, including yourself, is attacked. This does not accumulate with other damage reduction effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Reflects harmful effects granted on the Monster excluding inability effects.
effets.note: At the start of your turn

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: For each harmful effect granted on the enemies after the attack.
